name: BACH_0112
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Normal only; MUSK and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Normal}, 90% level | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 94th percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma/fat** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest negative term, but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 5, 6, 7) · context · 62% neoplastic nuclei, 93rd percentile of reference; discordant with Normal · Measured
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Present, but adds little in the concept model · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47 to 0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 5–7 are truly neoplastic; 62% tumor nuclei contradicts a Normal call.
- Calibration is dataset-level: ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03 to 0.18) on 132 images.

## Check on the slide
1. **5, 6, 7** — Confirm whether nuclei are neoplastic; HoVer-Net counted 56–65 neoplastic nuclei per region.
2. **5** — Highest per-region invasive risk (17%); assess nuclear atypia.
3. **8, 10, 11** — Verify two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
